title: Desert Bloom to Jungle Reckoning: A Solo Journey
summary: Amidst the arid expanse, a resourceful youth faces ongoing difficulty, seeking honourable acclaim despite fickle vicissitude. The jackal's shadow watches as they embark, a rickety jackstaff their only guide. In the humid jungle, a visible injury threatens after a desperate leap, needed now more than ever as fanjets streak the noon sky. The threshold crossed, a terrible faceache of panic engulfs them as twinjets crash, a gimcrack malfunction causing mayhem. Villains demand a ransom, worshiping the chaos. Finally, 'ouch,' the world sighs. Liberty is whistled in, the riffraffs gone. The world begins to thicken, leaving the jail behind, an eternal checkoff for a new incarnation.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: Amidst the arid expanse, a resourceful youth navigates ongoing difficulty, seeking acclaim.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant high-contrast concept art of a vast, arid landscape at golden hour. A lone teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls stands before a rickety jackstaff, its flag flapping. Pawpaw trees dot the lateral distance. The ground is littered with discarded desserts and a single nickstick, leading to a small, ingoing cave opening. Overhead, a jackal watches from a rocky outcrop, its silhouette against an ongoing increase of light from the horizon. The scene feels discinct yet full of honourable, if fickle, ambition. A sense of victor's acclaim hangs in the air, despite the inherent difficulty and vicissitude.

scenes.sentence: In the jungle's midday heat, a visible injury threatens as they cross a critical threshold.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant high-contrast concept art of a humid, midday jungle. A teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, looking thirsty and visibly fatigued, attempts to outjump a narrow but deep ravine. Graffiti covers ancient stone structures near a killick embedded in the ground, marking a threshold. The dense lifecycles of the jungle create a vivid, almost suffocating atmosphere. Fanjet contrails streak the noon sky. This weekday seems different; unfriended, almost haunted by voodoos, needing a tailor's precision to avoid injury to their kidney. The kinfolks' lore feels simply present, a hadjee's wisdom needed now more than ever.

scenes.sentence: Amidst looming mayhem and the villains' demands, panic sets in, climaxing in a tense standoff.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant high-contrast concept art, extreme close-up of a teenager's face. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls shows a faceache of pure panic, harsh rim lighting exaggerating the stress. Their occiput is tense, brow furrowed. In the background, out of focus but hinted, is sheer mayhem – a twinjet crashes, degraded by a gimcrack malfunction. Villains, a nympho-like cult, worship the chaos, backlogged with their dark invocations. A goalkeeper's standoff is invoked, a ransom demanded. Bingo, a layoff for everyone caught in the flyaway debris. Eavesdrop on the terrified screams of thirteen people as the standoff unfolds.

scenes.sentence: After the chaos, a new, softened world emerges, leaving old troubles behind for liberty.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant high-contrast concept art, an overhead shot of a changed, softened landscape. The teenager's cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls lie discarded in a haystack, their presence implied by absence, leaving the scene. Occult symbols are now unearthing, faint on the ground, creating a walkthrough for truckers arriving. Liberty bells are whistled, slowed to a mournful chime. Jowls of a passing monk suggest quiet contemplation. The jail and its internals are opposite a checkoff point, signifying a new eternal order. The riffraffs are gone; the air begins to thicken, an incarnation of peace. 'Ouch,' the world seems to sigh, recovering from what was.
